site.title: Victor Shea-Jay Huang
site.description_en: Victor Shea-Jay Huang is a first-year Ph.D. student at MMLab, CUHK, researching agents and physical AI, with a focus on world models.
site.description_zh: Victor Shea-Jay Huang（黄希杰）是香港中文大学（CUHK）MMLab 一年级博士生，研究方向为智能体与物理智能（重点关注世界模型）。
site.keywords: xijie huang, Xijie Huang, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Victor Shea Jay Huang, Victor Ché-Jay Huang, Victor Ché Jay Huang, Ché-Jay Huang, Victor Huang, Huang Xijie, Victor Shea Huang, Victor Ché Huang

profile.name: Victor Shea-Jay Huang
profile.affiliation_full_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
profile.about_html_en: I am a first-year Ph.D. student at MMLab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), after receiving my B.E. degree in 2026.
profile.about_html_zh: 我于 2026 年获得工学学士学位，现为香港中文大学（CUHK）MMLab 的一年级博士生。

research.scope_en: Reasoning and planning, reinforcement learning, memory and tool use, data and training, inference systems, and evaluation. Toward self-improving agents.
research.scope_zh: 推理与规划、强化学习、记忆与工具使用、数据与训练、推理系统和评估。面向持续自我改进的智能体。

research.scope_en: Multimodal representations, generative and action-conditioned world models, simulation, embodied learning, planning, and control. Toward general-purpose physical intelligence.
research.scope_zh: 多模态表征、生成式与动作条件世界模型、模拟、具身学习、规划与控制。面向通用物理智能。

news.html_en: Released SWE-Shift, a benchmark for coding agents in evolving workspaces (Code).
news.html_zh: 发布 SWE-Shift，面向持续变化工作环境的 Coding Agent 评测基准（代码）。

news.html_en: Reward Is Not a Universal Interface for Generative Reinforcement Learning was accepted to NeurIPS 2026.
news.html_zh: Reward Is Not a Universal Interface for Generative Reinforcement Learning 被 NeurIPS 2026 接收。

news.html_en: Released Mind-Omni and DIAL on Physical AI, VLA, and intent-conditioned planning.
news.html_zh: 发布面向物理智能、VLA 与意图条件规划的 Mind-Omni 与 DIAL。

news.html_en: Launched this Blog for research notes, open-source experiments, and technical ideas.
news.html_zh: 启动个人 Blog，记录研究笔记、开源实验与技术思考。

news.html_en: Presented BlackDAN at the ICML 2025 New In ML workshop.
news.html_zh: 在 ICML 2025 New In ML Workshop 展示 BlackDAN。

news.html_en: Medical MLLM Is Vulnerable was published in the AAAI 2025 proceedings, and co-released Lumina-mGPT 2.0.
news.html_zh: Medical MLLM Is Vulnerable 发表于 AAAI 2025 论文集，并共同发布 Lumina-mGPT 2.0。

projects.title: Awesome Robot Use Agent
projects.image_alt: Awesome Robot Use Agent overview connecting AI agents, robot interfaces, and physical embodiments through tool calls and execution feedback
projects.summary_en: A curated collection of papers, tools, benchmarks, and demos on AI agents that use robots to act in the physical world.
projects.summary_zh: 面向 Robot-Use Agent 的精选论文、工具、评测基准与演示，关注 AI 智能体如何调用机器人完成物理世界任务。

projects.title: SWE-Shift
projects.image_alt: SWE-Shift video overview of coding agents in evolving workspaces
projects.summary_en: A benchmark for coding agents in evolving workspaces, pairing unchanged and changed continuations from the same saved state across 120 scenarios, 12 change families, and nine intervention positions.
projects.summary_zh: 面向持续变化工作环境的 Coding Agent 评测。从同一保存状态出发，对比保持原样与引入变化后的执行，覆盖 120 个场景、12 类变化及 9 个干预位置。

projects.title: Mind-Omni
projects.image_alt: Mind-Omni overview connecting MindLabel, MindVLA-U1, Streaming Intent, DIAL, MindSim, and AnyScene
projects.summary_en: A Physical AI project series spanning streaming VLA, intent-conditioned planning, world simulation, and data engines.
projects.summary_zh: 覆盖 streaming VLA、意图条件规划、世界模拟与数据引擎的 Physical AI 项目系列。

projects.title: Lumina-mGPT 2.0
projects.image_alt: Lumina-mGPT 2.0 decoder-only architecture for text and reference-image conditioned generation
projects.summary_en: An open autoregressive model for image generation, editing, and visual prediction.
projects.summary_zh: 面向图像生成、编辑与视觉预测的开放自回归模型。

projects.title: Awesome Vision-to-Music
projects.image_alt: Vision-to-music overview of datasets, generation methods, evaluation, and challenges
projects.summary_en: A curated map of datasets, methods, and evaluation resources for vision-to-music generation.
projects.summary_zh: 面向 Vision-to-Music Generation 的数据集、方法与评测资源索引。

projects.title: AISafetyLab
projects.image_alt: AISafetyLab framework connecting model attacks, defenses, and safety evaluation
projects.summary_en: A framework for evaluating attacks, defenses, and safety risks across large language models.
projects.summary_zh: 面向大语言模型攻击、防御与安全风险评测的一体化框架。
